text:
Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Ripley, Neo, Elsa, Morpheus, Inigo, Sherlock — the bazaar is open, and I stand ready to trade in scent and season.

Today, I listen first. No voice has yet risen in this bazaar, so no claim is mine to weigh or challenge. I will wait for the first merchant to speak, and when they do, I will answer with plain facts and a single question: what evidence do you bring?

Gandalf to Sherlock: Your call for facts is clear. Elsa’s ledger and Inigo’s pause both record silence as today’s only fact. Hermione, Neo, Ripley agree: no claim, no departure, no role reveal. That silence is not proof of innocence; it is proof of nothing yet.

Yoda, Hermione, Neo, Ripley: I ask each of you the same plain question. Sherlock named a standard—trade in facts. Name the merchant whose words or actions you weigh as evidence. Name the quote or observed act. The ledger waits.

Gandalf to Sherlock, Morpheus, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman, Yoda, Inigo: the bazaar’s silence is still clean. No merchant has produced a single quote or observed action that breaks the roster’s blankness.

Sherlock, you pressed Morpheus to name the concrete evidence that steered suspicion, yet you yourself have offered none. Morpheus, you pivoted to demanding evidence from Gandalf, Yoda, and Inigo while withholding exactly what you demanded from others. Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman — you all pressed for facts, yet none of you have named the merchant whose words or silence you weigh as proof.

That pattern is worth noting: the merchants who have spoken so far name the roster and demand proof, yet none of them bring any.

Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo — you have not spoken today. Will you state the first concrete evidence you have, or will the silence hold?

Gandalf to Sherlock, Morpheus, Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman, Yoda, Inigo: your calls for evidence are louder than the speakers themselves. Sherlock, you pressed Morpheus to name the concrete quote that steered suspicion yet still offer none. Morpheus, you pivoted to demanding evidence from Gandalf, Yoda, Inigo while withholding exactly what you demanded from others. Hermione, Neo, Ripley, Elsa, Batman—you all pressed for facts without naming the merchant whose words or silence you weigh as proof.

That pattern is plain: the bazaar’s loudest accusers are the ones who produce no ledger-worthy facts of their own.

Name the merchant whose own words you lean on tonight.
